leadership.2.title: Kind + direct
leadership.2.body: Clear, direct communication keeps cross-functional teams working toward the same goal—and helps me understand what my team needs to succeed.
projects.ai-order-cloud.headline: Designing AI around the work—not the novelty.
projects.product-page-architecture.role: As the sole designer on this initiative, I helped diagnose the experience, synthesized behavioral and market evidence, proposed the new information architecture, and carried the direction through design exploration, prototyping, usability testing, and an A/B test.
projects.recognition-and-rewards.headlin: Powerful features for admins. Effortless engagement for everyone else.
projects.recognition-and-rewards.heading: Why it mattered.
projects.recognition-and-rewards.context: Recognition was one of our most-requested features and a natural extension of BambooHR’s “better together” story. As the first HRIS to offer it natively, our goal went beyond competitive parity: create an exceptional experience for admins and employees.
projects.recognition-and-rewards.adminCh: The Admin experience could not avoid complexity, but it could make that complexity navigable. I organized the system around clear decisions, progressive disclosure, and visible affordances so admins could understand what would happen before committing a change.
projects.recognition-and-rewards.problem: Recognition & Rewards had to serve two very different jobs. Admins needed control over eligibility, points, rewards, and automation. Employees needed a fast, natural way to recognize someone. The challenge was to minimize complexity on the admin side and remove friction from the employee side.
